title: "Given Up Fishing": US Airstrikes, Cartel Extortion Threaten Ecuador Fishermen
summary_full: Onshore, drug cartels have turned the small ports of Ecuador's Manabi province into a cocaine-trafficking hub, extorting local fishermen who are prized for their navigation skills.
